evidence_quote: Hours Paul can do homework = 15 hours - 2 hours = 13 hours
question_evidence_quote: This week Paul has practice 2 nights out of the week and can't do any homework those nights.
observed_error: The response subtracts 2 hours from the homework workload because two nights are unavailable.
violated_condition: Practice reduces available nights, not the 15 hours of homework that must be completed.
error_description: The response reduces the 15-hour homework workload by 2 hours because Paul has practice on two nights. Those nights restrict when he can work; they do not remove assigned homework. The subtraction is executed correctly, but its operands do not represent a valid reduction in required homework.
secondary_errors: The response counts only five nights in a week before subtracting the two practice nights, excluding the two weekend nights from the available nights.
